this is a terminal research conclusion, not a claim that the dossier is complete.","The notebook contains substantial cited material, but several records use search-result summaries, article-body descriptions, document summaries, or other non-pinpoint locators that remain recoverable extraction defects.","Gateway-only, duplicate, and bundled records were excluded from defensible evidence estimates where identifiable.","Source-family counts are lower than raw locator counts because multiple claims derive from the same report, wire service, institution, or duplicated underlying fact.","Missing evidence was treated as an unresolved gap, not as negative ruler evidence.","The strongest recurring limitations are incomplete independent verification of official claims, insufficient local-fact and subnational coverage, weak outcome measurement, and attribution gaps where national conditions are not enough to establish personal conduct.","Chapter 7B has the most consequential attribution limitation because the selected methodology requires a personal-integrity nexus.","The local-data disposition audit and external ledger are not fully reconciled, especially for Chapters 1B, 3B, 5B, 6B, 7B, and 8B."],"needs_continuation":false,"reviewer_summary":"Terminal evidence-quality review completed for all eight selected chapters and only the specified lenses. The dossier supports a substantial but uneven evidence handoff. Evidence is generally strongest for formal acts, public rhetoric, documented institutional conditions, conflict and humanitarian context, and reported rights incidents; it is weaker for independent effectiveness measurement, complete contrary evidence, local-fact breadth, precise locators, and personal attribution. Residual gaps are preserved for downstream confidence and interpretation. No scores or ranking advice were assigned.","schema_version":"ruler_evidence_review_v1","selected_theme_ids":[]}
